notes: Craft: the Village ring encloses the numeral 6 in scene 1; the finale scene keeps ape-mask and own-face as a two-layer disc so the inward turn stays visible without cancelling the apparatus. Telling boundary respected: written witnesses only; no unviewed ending invented; the fourteen-episode comma evidence reflected in the scene text. | E0 correction 2026-09-17: receipt-era sha256 replaced with actual-bytes hash at dbf3b17 (prior value kept as sha256_receipt_stale). #0 arrival — the ring (the Village) holds the assigned 6: the designation dims then is fixed bright (assignment as an act, not a state); the helicopter flies and becomes ↩ — brought back by remote control; Rover carries a repel field (the guardian that intercepts); slight gravity-down (the waking in the copied room); pointer repel/shove — exit denied, seizure on approach.

#1 world — ring layout: the assembly gathered around the Green Dome; Fifty-Eight becomes 2 — the staged assistant taking authority as incoming Two, the scene's own reversal staged as the sign's own replacement; a square-wave LFO hectors pointer strength (the tannoy cadence — the administered world speaks in announcements); pointer attract/pulse faint — the counterfeit gathering draws people in while controlling the routes by which answers matter.

#2 finale — the mask layers transform in place: red disc (outer mask) → square (the ape mask, the animal face) → pale disc (a face identical to his own); a steps-wave LFO replaces field turbulence (Degree Absolute's enacted stages of life); the embryo room and assembly dim so the unmasking carries the scene; vortex pointer with shove click — the interrogation reversed; duration 16, the longest beat — the week is held.

#3 count — THE 3D SCENE. z is the depth of the count's concealment: the visible administration nearest (2 at z +0.4, itself cycling bearer — position hop, tint to institutional red while the numeral persists), the assigned person at z 0, the withheld source of command deepest (1 at z −0.5), the Syn count 4+2 between — depth occlusion with a cold tint; the 1 stays dim (withheld); 6 carries a small repel field (denied authority over how his designation counts).

#5→0 return — line layout: the open road; the departure disc carries its own attract field at the frame's edge; the counting operation (⚖) stays centre-bright — release must reach the office of measure; pointer attract faint. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 opened with a ring confining the 6 and an escape (🚁) that returned as ↩; #5→0 has no ring at all, the 6's walk-out is not staged as recovery but as divergence (⇗ with others, lines of road), and what remains centre-frame is the ⚖ — the office the escape cannot simply leave behind; the automatic door is kept as the London-door's recall, so the return re-reads the arrival without revoking it.

Human-amplified staging: the political-count carrier and Q27 return are the record's Argued amplifications — scene bodies carry the landings (A02/A03, M-returns) and the guard (no symbolic equation of Rover/embryo room/Fifty-Eight/rocket to native determinations; human-amplified: no). Mythemic verbs only: the series figures the counterfeit gathering and the asymmetric count — no QL notation credited to McGoohan/Markstein, no formal theorem claimed from the programme.

Automation: auto-tannoy (pointer strength, square wave — the Village speaks in announcements) and auto-degree (turbulence, steps — the regression's stages): mechanical-TV character. Durations 12–16, transitions 1.2–2.0; the finale held longest.

glyph_rationales.1: Number One: the withheld source of command — the question the count refuses to answer.
glyph_rationales.2: Number Two: the office identified through changes of bearer — delegated authority continuing across replacements.
glyph_rationales.6: Number Six: the assigned designation — a person held within an administered position, refusing to be a number (title exchange, q001).
glyph_rationales.17: the seventeen-episode field: the declared extent of the work (ITVX listing order) whose premises stay located, not invented into one argument.
glyph_rationales.58: Number Fifty-Eight: incomprehensible, then English, then authority — the staged assistant who becomes the incoming Two.
glyph_rationales.🚁: the helicopter of "Arrival": the escape whose controls are taken over remotely and which brings its user back — the Village's reach into any route out.
glyph_rationales.↩: brought back: the same escape reversed — the return the Village administers, before the road that is genuinely open at #5→0.
glyph_rationales.⑃: the rocket countdown: Six's own act inside the masked assembly, freeing Two and Forty-Eight before the escape.
glyph_rationales.4+2: the Syn count 2+2²=6=4+2: the count that includes the relation generating it, against which the Village's assignment is the appointed political counterfeit.
glyph_rationales.⇗: the open road from the Village: escape with others and divergence after — no unviewed ending invented.
glyph_rationales.⚖: the counting operation itself: who selected the number, who answers for the selection — release must reach the office of measure, not only its occupant.
glyph_rationales.M40: the hidden evaluator: repeating the subject's score reproduces Two's deflection (return-to M40).
glyph_rationales.A32: the reflective return: the reply must be able to revise image, measure and institution.
glyph_rationales.·: the unnamed carrier — a formation whose sense is its shape alone (the Village ring, Rover's disc, the Green Dome, the embryo room, the mask layers); no glyph is pretended.
